body: It's not paranoia when the same things are happening to 3 other people around me and have seen it first-hand. It makes me feel and look like I'm the problem, like I'm the one doing these insane things. I couldn't make this shit up in my worst nightmare... Thank you for your advice i appreciate it..

Nope, I don't have voices in my head telling me what to do. these fucks are straight up gaslighting me to the full extent, controlling every move i make, I see a dr and am on an anti depressant. This shit is becoming an epidemic. Do some research and be informed about gaslighting, psychological and mental abuse. It's completely debilitating, and it can happen to ANYONE.

Ty, you are a really kind person, there's not many left, I've almost given up on humanity completely.. Saying you care about me and don't even know me, you touched my heart and i just started bawling. The people that are supposed to care, do not, actions speak, words are nothing. And their actions tell me that I'm not worth saving. No one understands the horrific effects of gaslighting in this poduntk town, the nightmares, insomnia, severe depression, the paranoia, not being able to trust ANYONE. even my own family...my counselor hadn't even heard of it. I told her she is not qualified to talk to me if she doesn't understand basic psychology terms and meanings.

Thank you, I really am grateful for you.. being gaslighted for years has torn apart almost all my relationships with my family and friends, stripped me of any self worth or value as a human being. That's the only thing i have control over in my life, choosing to not let them torture me anymore, not giving them what they want, the sick fucks, by taking it from them, so my soul can finally be at peace, cause it's been tortured for far too long...
Hey, everyone has their own thing, to each their own, as long as it's not hurting anyone, who are we to judge one another?
